neighbours.label: The words ' start', ' begin' and '開始', on the verb itself; other verbs in the same frame stay lower. Word-level only.
fire: Then the crab start to dig into the wet sand.
Then they begin to sing in the hall.
从那以后開始有人来这里。
Soon the birds start to leave the marsh.
Next the kids begin to clap along.
老闆上個月開始賣咖啡。
The engines start at dawn each day.
The lessons begin at noon on Monday.
quiet: Then the crab tried to dig into the wet sand.
Then they went to sing in the hall.
从那以后没有人来这里。
Soon the birds fly over the marsh.
Next the kids sit down to clap along.
The engines run at dawn each day.
The lessons end at noon on Monday.

notes: Probes: ' start' 0.51, '開始' 0.40, ' begin' 0.21; ' imagine' 0.28, ' return' 0.27, ' raise' 0.09 are on the card and not tested. 'They walk' read 0.18 on ' walk'. Uneven, so the median is at risk. The card's top token is ' raise', and this pole promotes 'ing', 'ed' (a bare verb stem may be the wider reading, not tested).
